nodes.name: BuffPetAuraToggle.tsx
nodes.summary: Opt-in per-pet toggle that folds a buff-pet's persistent aura (Force Field Generator, Barrier Reef, Triage Beacon) into character totals; detection and the toggle id are shared with the buff-pet-auras calculation seam.

nodes.name: BuffPetAuraToggle
nodes.summary: React component rendering the buff-pet aura toggle for a summon power, keyed on the shared mechanicAdjuster buffpet key.

nodes.name: DamageBlock.tsx
nodes.summary: Damage display block for the info panel: renders per-tier damage bars, base/enhanced damage modes, contextual AT-mechanic damage, and slotted-proc damage contributions for the selected power.

nodes.name: DamageBlock
nodes.summary: Top-level damage block component orchestrating the mode toggle, tier rows, and damage context for a power.

nodes.name: ModeToggle
nodes.summary: Toggle between damage display view modes (e.g. per-activation vs DPS/DPA style views).

nodes.name: DamageTiers
nodes.summary: Renders the tiered damage breakdown (base, enhanced, with mechanics/procs) as stacked tier rows for the power.

nodes.name: Tier
nodes.summary: Single tier row in the damage breakdown, pairing a label with its damage bar and value.

nodes.name: DamageBar
nodes.summary: Proportional horizontal bar visualization of a damage value, segmented by damage type/source.

nodes.name: DamageContext
nodes.summary: Contextual damage summary annotating AT-mechanic modifiers (crits, Scourge, Fury, etc.) applied to the displayed damage.

nodes.name: computeProcDamagePerActivation
nodes.summary: Computes expected damage a single slotted proc adds per power activation from its proc-chance data.

nodes.name: computeProcContribution
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-proc damage into the total proc contribution shown in the damage tiers.

nodes.name: EnhancementInfoContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Info-panel content for a slotted enhancement: IO set details, per-piece values at the current level, set bonuses with active counts, and schedule-aware enhancement value display.

nodes.name: EnhancementInfoContent
nodes.summary: Single large component rendering the full enhancement detail view for any enhancement kind (IO set piece, generic IO, origin, special).

nodes.name: InfoPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: The planner's main info panel and largest display component: full power detail (stats, effects, stacking, per-target adjustment, conditionals), incarnate power detail, and pet/pseudo-pet damage displays.

nodes.name: InfoPanel
nodes.summary: Panel shell that routes to PowerInfo, EnhancementInfo, or IncarnateInfo based on the UI store's selected content.

nodes.name: getStackingInfo
nodes.summary: Derives stack count and cap information for a power's stacking effects to drive the stacking display and multipliers.

nodes.name: adjustScaledValue
nodes.summary: Adjusts a NumberOrScaled effect value by a multiplier while preserving its scaled/plain shape.

nodes.name: multiplyScale
nodes.summary: Multiplies scaled effect values (used for stacking and targets-hit adjustments) across by-type and scalar forms.

nodes.name: adjustEffectsForTargets
nodes.summary: Adjusts per-target effect values by the targets-hit count so per-foe stacking effects display their combined magnitude.

nodes.name: PowerInfo
nodes.summary: Renders the complete detail view for one selected power: general stats, damage block, registry effects, proc controls, mechanic adjusters, conditionals, and buff-pet toggles.

nodes.name: renderGenesisExemplar
nodes.summary: Renders the Genesis incarnate slot's exemplar-effect rows within the incarnate detail view.

nodes.name: IncarnateInfo
nodes.summary: Detail view for a selected incarnate power: per-slot effect rows (Alpha, Destiny with decay timeline, Hybrid, Interface, Judgement, Lore, Genesis) with formatted values.

nodes.name: PetAbilityDetails
nodes.summary: Expanded detail rows for a single pet ability, showing its damage entries and non-damage effects.

nodes.name: SingleEntityDisplay
nodes.summary: Displays one pet entity's abilities and computed damage, including upgrade-tier filtering for Mastermind pets.

nodes.name: PetDamageDisplay
nodes.summary: Exported pet damage breakdown for a summon power: resolves pet entities, applies enhancements where allowed, and renders per-ability damage across upgrade tiers.

nodes.name: MechanicAdjusters.tsx
nodes.summary: Mechanic adjuster controls for the info panel: stance/mode radio groups, Domination and single-condition toggles, global vs per-power override radio groups, and contribution hints explaining what each adjuster changes.

nodes.name: MechanicAdjusters
nodes.summary: Top-level component grouping a power's conditional-effect adjusters into stance groups, radio groups, and toggles.

nodes.name: StanceModeGroup
nodes.summary: Radio group for stance-style mode selection (e.g. Bio Armor adaptations), keyed on the stance-group registry.

nodes.name: DominationAdjusterToggle
nodes.summary: Toggle wired to the global Domination-active UI state for Dominator conditional effects.

nodes.name: SingleToggle
nodes.summary: Single conditional-effect on/off toggle with global/per-power override awareness.

nodes.name: GlobalRadioGroup
nodes.summary: Radio group bound to a global adjuster value shared across all powers in the build.

nodes.name: PerPowerRadioGroup
nodes.summary: Radio group for a per-power adjuster override that can diverge from (and be cleared back to) the global setting.

nodes.name: ContributionHint
nodes.summary: Inline hint describing what an active adjuster currently contributes to the displayed power values.

nodes.name: PowerInfoBlocks.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable info-panel building blocks: power meta tag row, allowed-enhancements block, general stats table, and proc-chance rows with PPM math and area-factor detail lines.

nodes.name: PowerMetaTags
nodes.summary: Renders a power's metadata tag chips (power type, target, effect area, cast-through-mez, etc.).

nodes.name: AllowedEnhancementsBlock
nodes.summary: Lists the enhancement aspects and set categories a power accepts.

nodes.name: GeneralStatsBlock
nodes.summary: General power stats table: endurance cost, recharge, cast time (Arcanatime), range, target caps, and derived stats.

nodes.name: ProcChanceRow
nodes.summary: Displays a slotted proc's chance per activation with full PPM math (area factor, recharge inputs) and per-proc controls.

nodes.name: ProcDetailLine
nodes.summary: Secondary detail line for a proc row showing the effect summary and computed damage/uptime contribution.

nodes.name: formatEffectArea
nodes.summary: Formats a power's effect area (sphere radius, cone arc/range, chain, location patch) into a display string.

nodes.name: deriveSummonPatchArea
nodes.summary: Derives the effective AoE patch geometry for summon powers whose area lives on the summoned pseudo-pet rather than the power itself.

nodes.name: formatAttackType
nodes.summary: Formats a power's attack/defense type vectors (melee/ranged/AoE plus typed components) for display.

nodes.name: PowerInfoTooltip.tsx
nodes.summary: Hover tooltip variant of the power info display; shares the effect-rendering pipeline with InfoPanel including active-conditional merging and purple-patch scaling.

nodes.name: PowerInfoContent
nodes.summary: Builds the full tooltip body for a power: stats, damage, registry effects, conditionals, and incarnate/stance-aware adjustments.

nodes.name: PowerInfoTooltip
nodes.summary: Exported tooltip wrapper handling positioning, show/hide lifecycle, and content memoization for power hover tooltips.

nodes.name: SharedPowerComponents.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared power-effect rendering components used by InfoPanel, tooltips, and compare views: three-tier (base/enhanced/capped) stat rows, damage rows, collapsible effect groups, and the registry-driven RegistryEffectsDisplay engine.

nodes.name: ThreeTierHeader
nodes.summary: Column header for three-tier (base/enhanced/capped) stat tables.

nodes.name: ThreeTierStatRow
nodes.summary: Single stat row showing base, enhanced, and capped values with color-coded deltas.

nodes.name: DamageThreeTierHeader
nodes.summary: Header variant for damage three-tier tables.

nodes.name: DamageRow
nodes.summary: Damage row rendering a typed damage entry with base and enhanced values.

nodes.name: CollapsibleEffectGroup
nodes.summary: Collapsible section grouping related effect rows by category with expand/collapse state.

nodes.name: renderExtraInstanceRow
nodes.summary: Renders additional effect-instance rows (duration variants, conditional extras) beyond the primary effect value.

nodes.name: groupEffectsForDisplay
nodes.summary: Groups a power's registry effects into display sections ordered by category priority.

nodes.name: getConArrow
nodes.summary: Exported helper returning the con-color arrow indicator for enemy-level relative values.

nodes.name: getEffectBaseValue
nodes.summary: Resolves an effect's base display value across scalar, by-type, mez, and AT-table-scaled forms.

nodes.name: RegistryEffectsDisplay
nodes.summary: The registry-driven effect rendering engine: walks a power's effects through EFFECT_REGISTRY config to produce categorized, three-tier, stacking-aware effect rows shared by panel, tooltip, and compare views.
